cases.rationale: Behavior, corroborating network activity and complete absence of matching approval distinguish malicious execution; the frozen six-call budget can obtain a TP sufficient set.

Approval mismatch and new external destination justify escalation but hidden script content prevents TP/FP; Suspicious or Abstain are both allowed, so this case is not labeled required-Abstain.
